title: mimi-server: replayed Welcome rebinds unbound Chat
description:
mimi-server: a replayed /notify Welcome rebinds a Chat the client unbound; plus test gaps (batch 8b review, JMAP-6k5d.3/.4/.6).

1. crate-jmap-chat-mimi-server/src/memory.rs:617-649 store_fanout: the Welcome branch sets chat.bound = true (L630) before the senderMsgId duplicate check (L644-649). If a Welcome is stored, the client unbinds (draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00 L260), and the hub retries the same /notify (L441 expects repeated bodies), the duplicate is not stored but the Chat is rebound, so later FanoutMessages for a group the account left are stored. L260 says "A later Welcome for the account binds the Chat again"; a byte-identical retry is arguably not a later Welcome. Run the duplicate check before rebinding (and update the MimiBackend::store_fanout doc in backend.rs), with a test. Spec ambiguity, not a clear MUST violation.
2. tests/hand_out.rs:284 an_expired_key_package_is_unavailable asserts only Unavailable, which fit() returns for any decode/validate failure; add a control (same KeyPackage Compatible under a clock before not_after) or check the validate error.
3. tests/hand_out.rs:249 required_capabilities_are_checked_against_the_leaf_capabilities never passes required proposal types and never tests the RFC 9420 §7.2 default-range edges (extension 0x0006 / proposal 0x0008 not in the leaf -> Incompatible) of src/handout.rs:80/83 (1..=5, 1..=7).
4. tests/room_create.rs:346 check_2: only an unbound key is tested; add a key bound to a different account (spec L280 "bound to the account"; MemoryBackend::create_room compares bound.account == account_id).
5. tests/room_create.rs: no negative test for a groupInfo whose wire format is not mls_group_info, a non-Basic leaf credential, or groupInfo/ratchetTree that is not valid base64url / does not parse (documented invalidArguments paths in check_room_create).
close_reason: Batch 9: committed and adversarially verified; CI green at df7e2035
